title: Navigating RAG Optimization with an Evaluation Driven Compass: Atita Arora and Deanna Emery
talk_summary: The talk presents an evaluation-driven workflow for RAG: define domain-specific eval data and metrics, run incremental experiments, inspect worst cases, and add reranking/hybrid retrieval when naive retrieval fails. It reports faithfulness improving from 76 to just under 85 over 10 experiments without changing the generic QA prompt.

takeaways.what_they_do: They build an evaluation dataset with realistic inputs and expected outputs for the specific domain, then use it to compare RAG configurations instead of guessing.
takeaways.evidence_quote: a thorough evaluation of rag system has to be customized to suit that specific domain and data set

takeaways.what_they_do: After aggregate metrics, they inspect the two worst hallucination data points to find patterns such as over-indexing on query terms, then form a targeted hypothesis.
takeaways.evidence_quote: look into the data and here we've shown the two worst performing data points

takeaways.technique: Retrieve broad, rerank, keep top few
takeaways.what_they_do: They retrieve a larger candidate set, rerank with a separate ranker, and return only the top few documents to remove unrelated context before generation.
takeaways.evidence_quote: rerank the retrieved documents and then return only the top few thus weeding out some of the more unrelated ones

takeaways.what_they_do: They combine sparse and dense vectors so exact domain terminology and acronyms are captured alongside semantic similarity.
takeaways.evidence_quote: Hy search which combines sparse and dense vectors and these sparse vectors help us capture documents that share similar terminology

takeaways.technique: Single-variable incremental experiments with multi-metric tracking
takeaways.what_they_do: They change one RAG lever at a time and track multiple metrics, watching tradeoffs such as context relevance rising while chunk relevance or faithfulness falls.
takeaways.evidence_quote: making incremental changes evaluating using a combination of metrics that together can help you identify underlying issues
takeaways.numbers: faithfulness 76 to just under 85 over 10 experiments

takeaways.technique: Benchmark model swaps on the eval set
takeaways.what_they_do: They keep the same RAG configuration and swap the LLM, finding that the model change improved all tracked metrics.
takeaways.evidence_quote: using the same rag configuration but changing the llm improved performance across all our metrics
